records.purpose: Source is the project's zero-point: the conceptual condition before the archive separates things into entities, systems and relationships. It matters because every later distinction depends on declaring what counts as an origin rather than quietly assuming one.
mechanisms: provides a reference point for differentiation
allows the archive to ask what is assumed before analysis begins
connects mythic language to questions of origin and emergence
questions: Is Source being used as theology, metaphysics, narrative device or analytical placeholder?
What changes when the assumed origin changes?
failure_modes: Treating a symbolic origin as an empirical discovery
Using Source to end an investigation rather than begin one
records.use_in_project: Source belongs above the filing tree because it is an interpretive starting condition, not an ordinary object.

records.purpose: Father is the upper/source-side role in the project's mythology. Its analytical value is relational: Father only becomes intelligible through its relation to Son, Source, House, Axis and the Plane.
mechanisms: represents origin and organizing authority inside the myth
creates a vertical relation to the Son
provides a symbolic counterpoint to embodiment
questions: What is Father responsible for in the story?
How does the Father-Son relationship change through transformation?
failure_modes: Turning a project mythic role into a claim about real-world authority
Reducing Father to a generic synonym for God
records.use_in_project: Father is a relationship node, not a claim of sovereignty.

records.purpose: Father's House represents an interior point where scattered signals become integrated. It is useful as a model of coherence: many inputs can enter without losing their distinct histories.
mechanisms: integration combines signals into a model
centralization can improve coherence but can also concentrate control
questions: What counts as integration rather than suppression?
Which signals are lost when a system centralizes them?
failure_modes: Assuming unity requires uniformity
Treating an anatomical metaphor as a scientific discovery
records.use_in_project: It connects the mythic upper architecture to the project's interest in mind, memory and systems integration.

records.purpose: Heaven is the project's symbolic upper domain of integration, clarity, relationship and love. It is meaningful only as a defined interpretive domain, not as a geographic claim.
mechanisms: provides an imagined endpoint of coherence
organizes symbolic language around orientation and return
questions: What qualities define integration?
Can those qualities be translated into observable social or psychological conditions?
failure_modes: Confusing symbolic heaven with astronomical location
Treating moral hierarchy as a physical coordinate
records.use_in_project: Heaven is a mythic coordinate above the Plane, while empirical records remain on their own evidence layer.

records.purpose: The Ladder turns vertical difference into a route. A ladder is more useful than a static hierarchy because it implies movement, effort, intermediate states and the possibility of descent as well as ascent.
mechanisms: allows a system to describe return rather than one-way progress
questions: What does each rung measure?
What evidence shows movement between rungs?
Can the same ladder be traversed in both directions?
failure_modes: Assuming higher means better
Inventing levels without operational definitions
records.use_in_project: The Ladder is a model for transformation and the archive's scale, but it must not be mistaken for an empirical measurement unless a measurement is actually supplied.

records.purpose: The Narrow Gate represents a threshold with constraints. It makes the project's Door metaphor more specific: transformation is not simply movement but movement under conditions.
mechanisms: makes transformation costly or irreversible in the narrative
questions: What is excluded by the gate?
What must be relinquished to pass?
Which real-world transitions have analogous constraints?
failure_modes: Using difficulty as proof of truth
Turning a symbolic threshold into a literal supernatural mechanism
records.use_in_project: It is a transformation model, not a repository branch.

records.purpose: Vessel describes the carrier that allows something to cross a boundary. In the Potatoverse it makes the Son's function concrete: the carrier is part of the transformation rather than an external observer.
mechanisms: changes the relationship between origin and destination
questions: What is being carried?
What is changed by being carried?
What happens when the vessel fails?
failure_modes: Assuming the carrier is neutral
Confusing symbolic carrying with physical transmission
records.use_in_project: Vessel links Door, Son, body, interface and transformation.

records.purpose: The pineal gland is included as an explicit metaphor boundary. The project can use its position in the brain as imagery for an interface without claiming that neuroscience has established it as a metaphysical portal.
mechanisms: the gland is a real endocrine structure involved in melatonin regulation
the brain provides a physical substrate for perception and cognition
the metaphor maps an imagined interface onto a real anatomical object
questions: Which claims about the gland are actually scientific?
Which are symbolic?
Why is an interface metaphor attractive here?
failure_modes: Pseudoscientific identification of pineal anatomy with spiritual dimensions
Using scientific vocabulary to disguise an unsupported metaphysical claim
records.use_in_project: It is a test case for the project's evidence rule: real anatomy and symbolic interpretation remain separate but can be linked in the graph.

records.purpose: Tree of Strife is the negative structural counterpart to Tree of Life. It models a system whose branches continue to grow while the relationships that sustain the whole become competitive, extractive or destructive.
questions: Where does growth cease to regenerate its roots?
Which feedback loops turn competition into systemic damage?
What would restore reciprocal flow?
failure_modes: Treating every competition as pathological
Using the metaphor instead of identifying measurable mechanisms
records.use_in_project: It provides a systems lens for studying exploitation, fragmentation, fear and institutional decay.

records.purpose: Fear is an adaptive state that becomes analytically important when it changes decisions, relationships and institutions. It is not inherently negative; the archive studies when protection becomes control.
mechanisms: fear can coordinate groups under danger
chronic fear can narrow exploration and increase defensive behaviour
questions: What threat is being perceived?
Is the threat proportionate to the response?
Which institutions benefit from persistent fear?
What changes when perceived risk falls?
failure_modes: Treating fear as weakness
Treating all fear as irrational
Using a consciousness scale as a substitute for psychological evidence
records.use_in_project: Fear is better studied through psychology and Hawkinscale than as a repository folder of its own.

records.purpose: Anger is a high-energy response that can signal perceived injury, blocked goals or injustice. Its project value lies in tracking where energy becomes repair, conflict, domination or change.
mechanisms: appraisal identifies a violation or obstacle
social interpretation determines whether anger becomes protest, aggression or negotiation
questions: What produced the appraisal?
What action does anger make more likely?
What converts anger into constructive change?
failure_modes: Equating anger with moral truth
Treating anger as purely destructive
Ignoring the social context that produced it
records.use_in_project: Anger belongs inside psychological/emotional frameworks and relationship graphs rather than as a separate taxonomy branch.

records.purpose: Strife is a system condition in which relationships that could support mutual life instead produce conflict, domination or fragmentation. It is a pattern, not merely a feeling.
questions: What mechanism produces the conflict?
Who gains from the current structure?
What would change the incentives?
failure_modes: Moralizing conflict without identifying mechanisms
Treating disagreement as proof of dysfunction
records.use_in_project: Strife connects the symbolic Tree of Strife to empirical study of conflict and institutional incentives.

records.purpose: Swamp is a project metaphor for systems where many flows overlap, boundaries become difficult to see and extraction or dysfunction accumulates. It is useful precisely because it describes opacity and entanglement rather than a single villain.
questions: Where are the hidden flows?
Which actors benefit from opacity?
Which boundary would make the system easier to understand?
failure_modes: Using Swamp as a label for real people or groups without evidence
Treating metaphorical corruption as an empirical diagnosis
records.use_in_project: Swamp should point to measurable relationships and evidence rather than replace them.

records.purpose: Mud is the project's ground metaphor: difficult material conditions, buried history, friction and the starting point from which growth emerges. Its value is anti-romantic: transformation does not begin in clean abstraction.
mechanisms: stored resources can support later growth
questions: What is underneath the visible system?
Which constraints are being ignored?
What can actually grow from this substrate?
failure_modes: Romanticizing hardship
Treating the metaphor as geological science
records.use_in_project: Mud is the symbolic bridge between Matter and the Potato of Life.

records.purpose: Drain describes a one-way relationship in which resources, attention, value or information leave a system without sufficient renewal. It becomes useful when the quantity and direction of the flow can be identified.
mechanisms: attention is captured by competing demands
debt service can redirect future resources
brain drain can move skills between places
questions: What is flowing out?
At what rate?
Where does it go?
What replenishes the source?
failure_modes: Calling any exchange a drain
Assuming outflow is harmful without considering reciprocal returns
records.use_in_project: Drain is a graph pattern: it should become an edge with direction, quantity and provenance whenever possible.

records.purpose: Fragmentation is loss of coordination or coherence between components that still belong to the same wider system. It matters because fragmentation can increase duplication, cost and vulnerability without being visible in any one institution.
questions: What was previously connected?
What broke the connection?
Is reintegration beneficial or would it create excessive centralization?
failure_modes: Assuming integration is always better
Confusing healthy diversity with dysfunctional fragmentation
records.use_in_project: Fragmentation is a key diagnostic for the European graph and for the Tree of Strife.

records.purpose: Potatoism is the project's own interpretive framework. Its serious function is not to make ordinary objects mystical but to use the potato as a deliberately humble model for growth, memory, embodiment, humour, systems and transformation.
mechanisms: ordinary matter becomes a carrier of meaning
growth provides a model for development
root/fruit relations model hidden dependencies and visible outputs
humour prevents grand language from becoming self-important
the framework invites translation between symbolic and empirical layers
questions: Which claims are internal mythology and which can be tested externally?
Does the potato metaphor reveal a real relationship or merely decorate it?
What does the framework make visible that a conventional taxonomy would miss?
failure_modes: Treating Potatoism as empirical science
Using its symbolism to bypass contradictory evidence
Adding vocabulary without giving each term a function
records.use_in_project: Potatoism is strongest when it generates questions that can be investigated in the world and when its own myths remain clearly labelled as myths.

records.purpose: Spudlight names illumination emerging from grounded life. It is intentionally comic: the point is that meaning does not require abandoning ordinary material existence.
mechanisms: attention can reveal value in overlooked things
knowledge can move from obscure conditions into shared understanding
questions: What becomes visible when attention changes?
What does the metaphor reveal that literal language hides?
failure_modes: Treating symbolic light as physical energy
Using poetic language instead of explanation
records.use_in_project: Spudlight is a poetic connector between Potato, knowledge, attention and emergence.

records.purpose: North Axis joins symbolic orientation to geography and policy. It becomes analytically meaningful only when the symbolic North is separated from geographic north and then connected through explicit institutions, territories and relationships.
mechanisms: geography anchors the direction in actual places
questions: What does north mean in each context?
Which geographic and institutional relationships actually form the proposed axis?
Where does the symbolic model stop?
failure_modes: Treating a symbolic axis as a natural geopolitical law
Assuming geographic proximity creates political alignment
records.use_in_project: North Axis is the bridge between the project's mythic architecture and the North Programme/Economic Graph.
